name: AR_AUTOREC_EXCEPTIONS
description: The AR_AUTOREC_EXCEPTIONS table is a temporary table used to store exceptions found by Automatic Receipts and its related programs. These exceptions are part of the output of the Automatic Receipts program.  . The primary keys for this table are BATCH_ID, REQUEST_ID, PAYMENT_SCHEDULE_ID, and EXCEPTION_CODE.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the automatic receipt batch

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: PAYMENT_SCHEDULE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the invoice's installment being rejected by the Automatic Receipt Creation program

columns.name: PAYING_CUSTOMER_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier of the customer for whom the automatic receipt should have been created

columns.name: PAYING_SITE_USE_ID
columns.description: This column is meaningless unless the payment methods number of receipts rule is Per Site, then this is the site of the automatic receipt

columns.name: DUE_DATE
columns.description: This column is meaningless unless the Number of Receipts Rule is Per Due Date, then this is the maturity date of the automatic receipt.

columns.name: CUST_BANK_ACCT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the customer's bank account from which the money for the automatic receipt is taken

columns.name: REMIT_BANK_ACCT_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier of the remittance bank to which the automatic receipt will be deposited

columns.name: CUST_MIN_REC_AMOUNT
columns.description: This is the minimum receipt amount for creating a automatic receipt set at the customer level.

columns.name: BANK_MIN_REC_AMOUNT
columns.description: This is the minimum receipt amount for creating an automatic receipt at the remittance bank level.

columns.name: EXCEPTION_CODE
columns.description: This is the error message that tells you why this invoice installment was rejected by the Automatic Receipt Creation program.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: PROGRAM_APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Concurrent Program who column - application id of the program that last updated this row (foreign key to FND_APPLICATION.APPLICATION_ID).

columns.name: PROGRAM_ID
columns.description: Concurrent Program who column - program id of the program that last updated this row (foreign key to FND_CONCURRENT_PROGRAM.CONCURRENT_PROGRAM_ID).

columns.name: PROGRAM_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Concurrent Program who column - date when a program last updated this row).

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: ADDITIONAL_MESSAGE
columns.description: Message text contains additional information regarding the error.

columns.name: CASH_RECEIPT_ID
columns.description: Cash receipt  identifier.

columns.name: REMIT_BANK_ACCT_USE_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier of the remittance bank account use id to which the automatic receipt will be deposited

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
